title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.19358v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 keep lengthening their inference chains under test-time scaling, yet standard self-attention incurs quadratic cost in context length, making long-CoT deployment costly in production. We therefore introduce LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play replacement for self-attention that requires no full pretraining. LISA combines a linear-attention branch for long-range memory with a Lightning Indexer that dynamically selects the most relevant tokens for a sparse self-attention branch. The two branches are fused through a learned gate, so the model retains broad context while focusing computation on informative tokens.   We train LISA in two stages. tldr: LISA是一种无需完整预训练的即插即用稀疏注意力机制，通过融合线性注意力分支与动态token选择索引器，在保留长程记忆的同时大幅降低长上下文推理的计算成本。
